scenarios.disabled_reason: The DTLS gateway transport has one shared backend datagram flow and cannot report independent parallel connections correctly
scenarios.name: blocked_dtls_multi_connection

scenarios.disabled_reason: SCG reload currently diffs rules by name, so a same-name TLS profile change is not applied to the listener lifecycle and has no control-plane acknowledgement; profile-update measurements are withheld
scenarios.name: blocked_tls_profile_reload_ack

scenarios.disabled_reason: RSS/PSS and analytical encapsulation overhead are reported, but SCG does not expose owned framing/TLS/SHM copy, splice, zero-copy-success, or fallback counters; physical copy claims are withheld
scenarios.name: blocked_gateway_copy_accounting

scenarios.disabled_reason: TLS 1.3 has no NULL/integrity-only cipher suite; OpenSSL does not implement the draft TLS_SHA256_SHA256/TLS_SHA384_SHA384 codepoints, so an integrity-only TLS 1.3 handshake negotiates zero ciphersuites and never completes. Integrity-only is TLS 1.2 only — SCG now rejects the combination at config load (TRA #85). Profile removed from the executable matrix.
scenarios.name: blocked_integrity_only_tls13_tcp

scenarios.disabled_reason: TLS 1.3 has no NULL/integrity-only cipher suite; integrity-only is TLS 1.2 only (SCG rejects it at config load, TRA #85). Over UDS the dead handshake surfaced as a send-spin the harness watchdog had to kill. Profile removed from the executable matrix.
scenarios.name: blocked_integrity_only_tls13_uds

scenarios.disabled_reason: TLS 1.3 has no NULL/integrity-only cipher suite; integrity-only is TLS 1.2 only (SCG rejects it at config load, TRA #85). Over SHM the dead handshake surfaced as a send-spin the harness watchdog had to kill. Profile removed from the executable matrix.
scenarios.name: blocked_integrity_only_tls13_shm

scenarios.disabled_reason: TLS 1.3 has no NULL/integrity-only cipher suite; integrity-only is TLS 1.2 only (SCG rejects it at config load, TRA #85). Profile removed from the executable matrix.
scenarios.name: blocked_integrity_only_tls13_tproxy

scenarios.disabled_reason: WireGuard is a kernel-offload provider that needs CAP_NET_ADMIN, the wireguard module, and a peer network namespace; it is benchmarked by the privileged scripts/wg_bench.sh orchestration (see scripts/perf_gate.sh), outside the unified seshat run
scenarios.name: blocked_wireguard_script_orchestrated

scenarios.disabled_reason: subset146-psk is a pre-shared-key profile; PSK-only handshakes were removed in TLS 1.3, so SCG rejects subset146-psk on TLS 1.3 at config load: 'subset146-psk requires TLS 1.2 (PSK-only handshakes were removed in TLS 1.3)'. The PKI variant (subset146-pki) is TLS 1.3 capable and stays in the executable matrix. Profile removed from the executable matrix.
scenarios.name: blocked_subset146_psk_tls13
